content_sections.heading: About IIT Gandhinagar
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is an institute in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. This notice is issued by its Research & Development Office for a project run by the Center for Creative Learning.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Assistant I Vacancy Details 2026

rows.pay: Rs 28,000 to 53,000 per month depending on qualification and experience of the candidate

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Assistant I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility is as per Institute norms. The essential qualification is B.C.A/B.Sc. or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline. The minimum marks are 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. Previous experience in data entry, telecalling, coordination, or a similar role. Experience communicating with schools, teachers, or government offices. Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets and basic computer applications. Clear communication and confident telephone-handling skills. Ability to manage large datasets and maintain accurate records. Good spoken and written Hindi and English; knowledge of the local language is an advantage. Responsible, organized, and able to meet deadlines.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The role supports data management and communication with schools and education stakeholders. Key responsibilities: Enter, update and maintain information in Excel, Google Sheets and other digital platforms. Call schools and teachers to share information, follow up and respond to basic queries. Keep clear records of calls, responses and follow-up actions. Coordinate with schools, teachers, principals and government officials. Prepare basic reports and summaries as required. Complete assigned tasks accurately and on time.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting or appointment, and a higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves the right not to call an applicant for a selection test, or not to fill the position through this round, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The position is temporary. The duration of appointment is 1 year. House Rent Allowance is shown as NA, since the consolidated remuneration already includes HRA.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Project Assistant I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the application link on the IIT Gandhinagar recruitment site. Fill in and submit the online application by 20.11.2026. For queries, contact Prof Manish Jain at the email address given below.
